researchExceptions.description: Per-lens mechanical shift % for ET-D3QW200 and ET-D3QS400 is not clearly isolated from projector-level max shift figures across the catalog and manual; degree values found appear to represent keystone correction angle, not shift percent
researchExceptions.recommendation: Retrieve dedicated single-lens datasheet PDFs (e.g. ET-D3QW200 lens spec sheet) analogous to ET-D3QT500's if available, to isolate shift % per lens

researchExceptions.description: Sony VPL-GTZ380 lens throw ratios differ between the primary datasheet's main table (0.80-1.02:1 / 1.40-2.73:1, basis unstated) and a secondary table on the same PDF plus Sony Canada/Value Electronics reprints (0.85-1.09:1 / 1.49-2.91:1, explicitly for 16:9 display size)
researchExceptions.recommendation: Confirm with Sony professional support whether the differing values represent different aspect-ratio/display-size bases (16:9 vs. panel-native) rather than a genuine discrepancy; do not average or pick arbitrarily

researchExceptions.description: Barco UDX-4K32 spec sheet gives only a projector-level combined lens-shift range (-100% to +130% V, up to +/-40% H) 'depending on lens' rather than per-TLD+-lens shift figures
researchExceptions.recommendation: Locate individual TLD+ lens datasheets (e.g. TLD+ 0.37, TLD+ 1.25-1.6) on barco.com resource/downloads pages for lens-specific shift, F-number, and throw-basis data

researchExceptions.description: VPL-GTZ380 is a home-cinema/high-end consumer product rather than professional installation/rental gear; included per user instruction but market segment must remain clearly flagged as home_theater_high_end and not merged with professional large-venue categories
researchExceptions.recommendation: Keep segregated in any filtered views of the database that target professional AV/rental use cases

researchExceptions.description: Panasonic manual throw-ratio tables for ET-D3QT600/ET-D3QT700 show an apparent value overlap between the 16:9 column of one lens and the 4:3 column description text extracted from the search snippet; this may be a search-tool extraction artifact rather than a true source conflict
researchExceptions.recommendation: Re-verify exact per-aspect-ratio throw ratio table directly from the official manual PDF pages (not just search snippet) before using QT600/QT700 16:9 and 4:3 values in production calculations

researchExceptions.description: Full TLD+ lens family (0.65-0.85, 0.8-1.16:1, 1.5-2.0:1, 2.0-2.8:1, 2.8-4.5:1, 4.5-7.5:1, 7.5-11.5:1) referenced in UDX-4K32 spec sheet was not individually profiled in this pilot pass; only 0.37 and 1.25-1.6 lenses were built out as optical_profiles records
researchExceptions.recommendation: Expand Barco lens coverage in next research phase by pulling each TLD+ lens's individual datasheet
